candidate_code_fingerprint.method: Obtain relative paths with git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z; deduplicate and sort. Exclude paths beginning docs/ and names ending .md or .tsv. For each remaining path hash its UTF-8 bytes, NUL, current file bytes, NUL using SHA256. Ignored paths are excluded by git.
